messages:
alex: Heads-up — the billing forecast for t-3378 shows a ~3x token spike around 01:13 UTC. Not visible in per-tenant logs, but it lines up with the adaptive-quota-window canary rollout.
sara: Which canary? the one we flipped at 01:10? can you paste the timeline?
alex: timeline: 01:08 deploy, 01:12 enable adaptive-quota-windows on 10% traffic, 01:13 we see duplicate meter emits for that tenant (short burst ~3m). grep shows repeated `emit_meter` with same seq ids.
nate: That smells like shadow routing double-writing when fallback/tagging isn't set. Do we mark `orig=shadow` anywhere? I thought we left that out to keep event shape small.
bella: From console perspective this is painful — preview shows the spike and customers freak out. Can we at least hide shadowed events from the invoice preview until rollout stable?
alex: quick snippet I ran: ```bash
$ grep "emit_meter" /var/log/metering/2026-03-02.log | grep t-3378 | head -n 20
2026-03-02T01:13:08Z emit_meter tenant=t-3378 seq=998231 src=proxy route=chat-v1
2026-03-02T01:13:08Z emit_meter tenant=t-3378 seq=998231 src=shadow-proxy route=chat-v1
```
ingest-bot: :warning: metering.alert: duplicate_event_rate increased from 0.2% to 4.7% at 2026-03-02T01:13:10Z
sara: Proposed immediate mitigation: 1) pause canary for adaptive-quota-windows globally; 2) have console preview ignore events with `emit_type=shadow` (we can plumb a temporary flag from the canary patch); 3) add an alert when preview vs ledger delta > 5%.
nate: Longer-term we should add explicit fields on metering events: `policy_id`, `emit_type` (primary|shadow|replay), and `event_id` (uuid). Pipeline dedupe should prefer `event_id` when present. That avoids relying on seq/route heuristics.
bella: UX ask: expose route-level provenance in Console -> Metering preview (show primary vs shadow counts, and a toggle to include/exclude). That helps CS during rollouts.
alex: Implementation constraints: adding `event_id` requires touching edge proxies + proxy-lib + SDKs. Rolling that out will take weeks. A soft path: add `emit_type` first (cheap), and a small `policy_id` string. Then do `event_id` as follow-up.
sara: Agreed. For the short-term patch, can infra add a shadow flag rollout so we can filter in the preview UI? I'll open a ticket and assign eng-platform + billing.
nate: Also: pause adaptive-quota-windows rollout and revert the canary in staging->prod pipeline until we have the `emit_type` marker.
bella: I'll update the product note for customers (preview-only anomaly) so CS can calm tenants.
alex: Thanks — I'll attach the grep output and example duplicate event pairs to the ticket. Let's also capture a quick migration plan: 1) emit_type + policy_id (1 week), 2) console filter + alert (1 week), 3) event_id + pipeline dedupe (3+ weeks).
sara: Perfect. tagging @eng-platform @billing. We'll monitor ingest-bot and re-open if rates climb. :thumbsup:
